verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments platform that deposits funds to merchants, so international seller payouts are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence covers only deposit frequency, ACH bank validation via Plaid, and amount splits. Nothing documents local-currency payouts, FX handling, or settlement to non-US local bank rails.

support.subject: As a finance lead, international sellers get paid properly — local-currency payouts, documented FX handling, and settlement to local bank rails rather than expensive wires
